quotes.text: Our trip made it obvious that Keith has decades of experience fishing for salmon in Puget Sound. If you want to learn the most successful salmon fishing techniques and immediately improve your success, being guided by Keith will be money very well spent. Our trip with Keith resulted in consistent action throughout the day because he moved to locations he knew would be the most productive as the day progressed. We’re looking forward to another trip if lucky enough to find an open day on his schedule.

Captain Keith is a gem! Super nice and incredibly experienced. If you’re a little rusty he gently corrects you and moves on. We luckily went on a day where you could keep kings so our group of 3 went home with 1 pink, 2 kings and 3 cohos. He’s got a great old school Seattle vibe and knows as much about the city and it’s neighborhoods as he does about fishing (which is a lot). Definitely hiring him again for my dads upcoming birthday.

Captain Keith took my boyfriend and his dad out and we had the absolute best time. I caught our dinner (13 lb Coho) along with a King and sharks. We all caught at least 1 salmon and 1 shark. Captain Keith kept the bait up which was hard to do since once of us was always reeling something in. Highly recommend this super special experience.💕

Captain Keith was the ultimate guide for our group. Great job on getting us on fish thanks to his skills and experience, but more importantly his personality made a nice morning on the Sound even better. Looking forward to the next time we can fish!

Captain Keith was an awesome guide. He put us on the fish and made sure that we had the best experience. Mooching was a good hands on way to salmon fish. Captain Keith next time you’re in KC we’ll have to go catfishing. Thank you!
Great charter with Captain Keith. Spent a beautiful day on the Sound and caught a variety of fish. Captain Keith did a great job putting us on fish.
